arabic text: WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI}
english translation text: Salam, Ghazi; salam, Ghazi. You are the Imam of loyalty, Ghazi.

arabic text:
JAGAH JAGAH HAI ALAM GAWAHI
DILO'N PE TERI HAI BADSHAHI
LABO'N PE TERA HI NAAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
{SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI}.
english translation text:
Standards everywhere bear witness;
you rule over every heart.
Your name alone rests
upon our lips, Ghazi. You
are the Imam of
loyalty. Salam, Ghazi; salam, Ghazi.

arabic text:
TERE ALAM KA HAI HAM PE SAYA
ALAM PE SAYA HAI PANJETAN KA
BALAND TERA MAQAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
english translation text:
The shade of your
standard rests over us, and
the Panjetan's shade rests over your
standard. Your rank is exalted,
Ghazi. You are the Imam of
loyalty. Salam, Ghazi; salam, Ghazi.

arabic text:
ALAM KA JAB SE HUA HAY SAYA
ZAMEEN-E-KARB-O-BALA PE MOULA
TERA HAI CHALTA NIZAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
{SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI }..(2)
english translation text:
Since your standard cast
its shade upon the land
of Karbala, Maula, your
order prevails there, Ghazi. You
are the Imam of
loyalty. Salam, Ghazi; salam, Ghazi.

arabic text:
TU BAWAFA HAI TU LAFATA HAI
BE AASRO'N KA TU AASRA HAI
JAHAN MAIN CHARCHA HAI AAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
english translation text:
You are faithful and
courageous; you are the support
of those without support. Your fame
is widespread throughout the world,
Ghazi. You are the Imam of
loyalty. Salam, Ghazi; salam, Ghazi.

arabic text:
HUSSAIN MOULA SE PYAAR KARNA
HUSSAIN PER JAA'N NISAAR KARNA
YEHI HAI TERA PAYAAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
english translation text:
To love Maula Hussain
and sacrifice your life for Hussain—
this alone is your message, Ghazi.
You are the Imam of loyalty.

arabic text: {SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI\nWAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI }
english translation text: Salam, Ghazi; salam, Ghazi.\nYou are the Imam of loyalty.

arabic text:
JO TERE BAZOO QALAM NA HOTE
ASEER AHL-E-HARAM NA HOTE
NA JATI ZAINAB YU SHAAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
BAWAFA YA ABBAS..(2)
english translation text:
Had your arms not been
severed, the sacred family would not
have become captives, and Zainab would
not have travelled to Shaam in
this way, Ghazi. You are the
Imam of loyalty. Salam, Ghazi; salam,
Ghazi. Faithful one, Ya Abbas.

arabic text:
GHULAM SHARMINDA HAI YE MOULA
NA LAASHA KHAIMO'N MAIN LEKE JANA
THA LAB PE TERE KALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
{SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI }..(2)
english translation text:
Your servant is ashamed, Maula:
'I could not take the
body back to the tents'— these
words were upon your lips,
Ghazi. You are the Imam of
loyalty. Salam, Ghazi; salam, Ghazi.

arabic text:
JAWAD O SARWAR JAB AAYE SARWAR
BUREEDA BAZOO THA IBN-E-HAIDER
TO KAISE KARTA SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
SALAM GHAZI SALAM GHAZI
WAFA KA TU HAI IMAM GHAZI
BAWAFA YA ABBAS..(2)
english translation text:
O Jawad and Sarwar,
when the King reached him,
Haider's son's arms were severed.
How could he offer salam,
Ghazi? You are the Imam
of loyalty. Salam, Ghazi; salam,
Ghazi. Faithful one, Ya Abbas.
